correctness.rationale: A complete four-case transition partition for (Z,L) has integer weights 1,Z,L-Z,n-1-L summing to n; it yields the two stated exact polynomial recurrences. The exact nonstandard commutator (n+D)A_n=(A_n-1)(n-1+D)+2(u+n-1) is valid by direct differentiation. Starting from G_2=H_2=u, induction proves 2H_n=(n-1)G_n+uG_n', and coefficient extraction gives the claimed conditional mean for all feasible z and all n>=2. The auxiliary fixed-point marginal follows by solving the G recurrence and is independently known. Covariance/variance relations follow with n=2 excluded from correlation. Standalone rational enumeration up to n=9 and transform recurrences to n=25 corroborate without replacing proof.

value.rationale: The invariant is an exact structural local-to-global regression valid for every tree size and every attainable local count, offering finite-sample conditional prediction from a natural root-fringe motif. It proves a universal slope one-half, yields a fixed covariance and vanishing correlation, and is stronger than a univariate limiting Poisson law or a single unconditional covariance. It is motivated by the literature on random recursive root branches and global leaf statistics rather than chosen as an arbitrary narrow numerical case.
